description: He also said the state would develop a "modern AI ecosystem" in collaboration with Microsoft, Google, and Sarvam AI, under which teachers would be trained on the latest technologies in artificial intelligence.
body_lead: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary, in a Teachers' Day message posted on X, announced a set of education-sector resolutions by the state government, including a new teacher training university and a separate pay scale for honorarium-based teachers.
